messages:
lina_privsec: Heads-up: DSAR deletion for subj 12ab failed after KMS rotation. Worker shows AccessDenied when attempting to decrypt archived snapshot. Suspect key policy lost the erasure SA during last RBAC sweep.
ashwin_eng: Paste the worker error?
lina_privsec: ```
2026-04-02T02:14:02Z dsar-worker ERROR KMSDecryptError: AccessDenied: projects/.../cryptoKeys/dsar-key: caller does not have permission
job=erase-12ab snapshot=snap-9f3
```
mike_oncall: I'm on it. Which SA is used by the erase job?
lina_privsec: `sa-dsar-eraser@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
mike_oncall: Key IAM shows only infra viewers; no dsar SAs. We ran a cleanup last week that pruned non-exempt SAs.
tara_legal: Requester asked for status. If we miss the statutory window we must log a retention exception. Legal ok with emergency one-off access for erasure, but need full chain of evidence.
ashwin_eng: Triage steps: confirm alias -> version, grab key IAM policy, and pull KMS audit entries for decrypt attempts.
lina_privsec: Alias -> version 5 (rotated). No dsar SAs in policy. Snapshot metadata has `hold=true` from archival pipeline.
mike_oncall: Short-term fix: grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `sa-dsar-eraser` for 1 hour, run erase, capture KMS audit + job logs, then revoke. Need legal approval note attached to IAM change.
tara_legal: Approved for a one-hour emergency grant to complete erasure for DSAR 12ab. Approval note: "Emergency decrypt for DSAR 12ab due to KMS policy drift after rotation; actions logged."
lina_privsec: Metadata to capture: dsar_id=12ab, snapshots=[snap-9f3], operator=mike_oncall, approval=tara_legal, retention_exception=false.
mike_oncall: Applying binding now with approval note and infra change ticket.
ops-bot: Incident INC-5019 opened by lina_privsec. Severity=P2. https://incidents.redwood/5019
mike_oncall: Re-running erase job...
mike_oncall: Erase job succeeded: "erasure complete for 12ab; snapshots purged." KMS audit shows Decrypt by `sa-dsar-eraser` at 2026-04-02T02:21:18Z. Revoking temporary grant.
tara_legal: Please upload IAM change record, KMS audit entry, erase job log, and requester acknowledgement. We'll verify and close.
lina_privsec: Action items: 1) add DSAR SAs to KMS onboarding checklist (owner: ashwin_eng). 2) add rotation rehearsal in DSAR e2e tests (owner: ashwin_eng). 3) design rewrap automation for long-lived snapshots (owner: mike_oncall). 4) add alert for KMS policy drift when DSAR SAs are removed (owner: mike_oncall).
ashwin_eng: I'll file tickets and include an emergency grant template in the runbook.
mike_oncall: Drafting rewrap plan and alert rule.
ops-bot: Incident INC-5019 status: Mitigated by mike_oncall. Evidence bundle: https://incidents.redwood/5019/evidence
